relationships.subject: human DRG repetitive-spiking neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: TAC1 expression is 3.5-folder higher in repetitive-spiking neurons compared to single-spiking neurons (FDR = 2.4E-05)

relationships.subject: human DRG repetitive-spiking neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPA1 is 4-fold higher in repetitive-spiking neurons compared to single-spiking neurons (FDR = 0.01)

key_findings: Patch-seq linked three human DRG electrophysiological E-types to transcriptional nociceptor subpopulations; C-fiber neurons were enriched in repetitive spiking.
Donors with pain history showed hyperexcitable repetitive-spiking neurons and higher per-neuron SCN9A and SCN10A mRNA (Nav1.7 and Nav1.8).
